description: 5-fold stratified CV of the full hybrid pipeline (XGBoost + LSTM + fusion + calibration), checking class-balance stability and performance stability across independently held-out folds.
conclusion: Data is NOT balanced (22.4% vs 77.6%, by design -- not resampled). Class balance is stable across all 5 folds (std 0.0016%), confirming it's a real property of the data, not a fluke of one split. AUC is stable across folds (0.884-0.891, std 0.0024), confirming the reported 0.892 single-split AUC is not a lucky split.
